# HEM v0.7.5b2 — Historical targets and controller output in trends

This beta adds recorded controller targets and output evidence to HEM's existing trend window, so you can compare the measurement with the target that applied at that time.

## Compare measurements and targets

- Keeps the recorded measurement visible and adds a separate stepped target for each matching controller. Profile and target changes are recorded when they occur; today's target is not drawn over older measurements.
- Matches control history to the chart's exact feedback sources and measurement quantity. Different controllers remain separate, and temperature targets use the chart's temperature unit.
- Shows mold control's surface-humidity target on the mold chart and its effective room-air humidity target on the corresponding humidity chart.
- Adds a separate output view with the available HEM demand and reported device output. A requested percentage is not presented as measured power, airflow or confirmed physical activity.
- Keeps the existing time ranges, inspection controls and responsive trend window. Point inspection includes the recorded target, output and operating context where available.

## Recorded evidence and continuity

- Collects bounded local control history and restores it after Home Assistant restarts. Retained data is served through the same authenticated recommendation-sensor ownership checks as the dashboard.
- Preserves source changes, unavailable evidence and restart gaps. Target and output lines end at observed boundaries; opening a chart never extends a historical value or writes device state.
- Starts recording with this version. Earlier target and output values cannot be reconstructed from today's settings; older measured history remains available according to its existing retention.
- Records a target only when HEM has a valid control goal. Off, unknown target evidence and Manual without an explicit HEM target do not acquire an invented target line.
- Adds storage, provenance, authorization and production-card tests, including Chromium checks for the combined trend display.

This feature reads existing control decisions and device reports. It does not change control targets, PID tuning, actuator permissions or safety timing.

Update through HACS with beta releases enabled, restart Home Assistant to load the integration changes, and refresh the dashboard to load the updated card.
